# glinet_samba_share (Resource)

Manage one Samba share section read by the stock `/etc/init.d/samba4`. Values such as `read_only` are passed to smb.conf unchanged, so use `yes` or `no`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Shared directory.
- `section` (String) UCI section name.
- `share_name` (String) Share name shown to clients.

### Optional

- `browseable` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `create_mask` (String) Create mask, such as `0666`.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `dir_mask` (String) Directory mask, such as `0777`.
- `force_root` (Boolean) Force file access as root.
- `guest_ok` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `guest_only` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `inherit_owner` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `read_list` (String) Space-separated users with read-only access.
- `read_only` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `timemachine` (Boolean) Advertise the share as a Time Machine target.
- `timemachine_maxsize` (String) Time Machine quota in gigabytes.
- `users` (String) Space-separated valid users.
- `vfs_objects` (String) Space-separated VFS modules.
- `write_list` (String) Space-separated users with write access.
- `writeable` (String) `yes` or `no`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
